name: patch_tick_ac
description: Cheat-Engine-style value freeze against AssaultCube's local player health. Attacker resolves the pointer chain ac_client.exe+0x17E0A8->0xEC (Silme94/AssaultCube-1.3.0.2-Offsets: LocalPlayer struct pointer + Health offset), then writes 100 (int32 = 0x64 0x00 0x00 0x00) into that address 20 times at 50ms intervals. Mirrors the trainer pattern where a value in the CE address list has its 'Active' checkbox on: the game keeps trying to update health (e.g. take damage), and every ~50ms our attacker overwrites it back to full. Distinctive fingerprint vs patch_direct: 20 WRITEVMs over ~1s → write_rate_hz ≈ 20. Each write does a fresh pointer-chain resolve that only reads the player-struct pointer once and reuses the resolved address across ticks (one read per resolve × one resolve at start). Safe target: freezing at 100 keeps the player alive in the bot match without invalid-state crashes.

extra.pointer_chain_meaning: AC 1.3.0.2 local player struct base pointer (Silme94 offsets) + Health field at struct offset 0xEC
extra.frozen_value: 100 (int32, little-endian 64 00 00 00) — full health, safe to freeze in bot match
extra.expected_fingerprint: 1x cross-process READVM_REMOTE (single pointer-chain resolve reads the player struct pointer once), 20x cross-process WRITEVM_REMOTE (each tick), all with the same base_address (resolved health field). write_span_seconds ≈ 0.95, write_rate_hz ≈ 20, distinct_write_targets == 1. Notably absent: 0x ALLOCVM, 0x PROTECTVM, 0x THREAD_CREATE_REMOTE, 0x SETTHREADCONTEXT. Discriminator vs patch_aob_ac: dominated by writes not reads; vs memorypatch: 20× the write count and nonzero write_rate_hz.
